aval-rail.ringkas: Aval is a shop till for the ZeroClaw agent runtime. The owner types a charge the way they would tell a waiter, the agent turns it into a Solana Pay request, and the customer's own wallet pays it. The agent holds no key on that path and signs nothing.

aval-core.ringkas: SDK-less Solana substrate for WebAssembly (wasm32-wasip2) agent-tool plugins. This is the canonical source for the core that powers the Aval suite of ZeroClaw plugins (nonce-vault-init, durable-tx-build, approval-recheck — see zeroclaw-plugins PR #98).

x402gate.ringkas: HTTP 402 pay-per-call infrastructure for autonomous agents, settled on Solana devnet.

veylock.ringkas: Veylock separates an agent's intelligence from its authority. Any model can propose an action, but settlement must pass a deterministic policy covering asset scope, per-action size, rolling budget, drawdown, operating mode, and emergency halt.

kinferry.ringkas: Kinferry is a Solana devnet remittance-agent MVP built around one rule: an agent may prepare a transfer, but it cannot decide who is trusted or exceed the sender's authority.

anamneon.ringkas: Riwayat penyakit pasien yang dikunci di Solana — bisa dibuktikan asli dalam hitungan detik, tanpa satu byte data medis pun bocor ke publik.

visitrail.ringkas: VisitRail is an evidence-first operating layer for home care agencies. It verifies visit evidence, keeps AI drafting grounded, makes staffing recommendations explainable, and exposes only finalized updates to families.

servetrace.ringkas: Restaurant compliance controls that turn temperature readings, corrective actions, labor-safe schedules, and inventory movement into enforceable operating decisions and tamper-evident proof.

axleveto.ringkas: AxleVeto is a verifiable dispatch safety interlock for commercial fleets. It connects grounded driver inspections, critical maintenance intervals, role-gated release authority, and a tamper-evident proof ledger into one enforceable decision: a vehicle may dispatch, or it may not.

briefrail.ringkas: Creative operations software that keeps briefs, deliverable feedback, approval gates, time, and invoice evidence on one rail.

vowrail.ringkas: Transaction firewall and proof-carrying policy rail for autonomous Solana agents.

freightlatch.ringkas: FreightLatch is a server-enforced dispatch compliance system for small and mid-sized freight fleets. It blocks assignments when a driver is out of Hours-of-Service, a vehicle is on maintenance hold, or a load record has not passed human review.

childcareos.ringkas: ChildcareOS is a safety operations prototype for childcare centers. It demonstrates three tightly scoped workflows.

dwellnerve.ringkas: DwellNerve is an early-warning operating system for rental portfolios: maintenance triage, lease-governed rent, scheduled compliance signals, tenant self-service, and optional Solana devnet evidence.

evercue.ringkas: Evercue is a live event-operations workspace for professional planners. The MVP connects the vendor pipeline, evidence-based AI assistance, deterministic budgets, a five-second shared run-of-show, scoped client/vendor access, and Solana devnet publication proofs.

autorepairos.ringkas: AutoRepairOS is an approval-gated repair-order MVP for independent automotive shops. Every estimate line item has its own customer token, technicians are blocked server-side from logging work against pending or declined scope, diagnostic drafts stay grounded in technician notes, and actual cost is tracked against the approved estimate.

civiflow.ringkas: CiviFlow is an accountability-first municipal service platform with two verifiable intelligence layers.

stewardlane.ringkas: Stewardlane is a compliance-first household CRM and AI drafting workflow for independent wealth advisory firms. It keeps AI output in a mandatory review state, preserves original and reviewed text, blocks common recommendation-like phrasing, and can anchor approved content hashes to Solana devnet.

galleryos.ringkas: GalleryOS is a photography-studio workflow prototype covering booking visibility, explainable human-confirmed culling, gallery preparation, and a private client selection experience.

mirrorqa-ai.ringkas: MirrorQA runs fixed synthetic-customer profiles against product journeys and keeps every friction finding tied to an observed step. This repository contains the public marketing site, evidence-first workspace, deterministic browser-action guardrail, live Groq decision endpoint, and Solana devnet proof workflow.

kernly.ringkas: A deterministic context compressor for LLM agents. No GPU, no API call, no model in the loop, and a receipt for every token it claims to save.

loomstack.ringkas: Loomstack A spec compiler that weaves five million addressable spec lines into context packs an agent can actually build from.

dissentgrid.ringkas: DissentGrid is an investment review board that treats disagreement as auditable decision data. Four fixed analytical lenses form independent positions, challenge specific claims, and produce a memo that keeps consensus separate from unresolved dissent.

accordos-ai.ringkas: Autonomous agent-to-agent B2B negotiation with deterministic authority rails, dual human approval, and optional Solana devnet proof anchoring.

veristart-agentic-feasibility.ringkas: Agentic AI feasibility analysis for startup ideas — Business Model Canvas plus automated market research, expressed as a nine-agent pipeline and a seven-factor weighted score.

antigravity-ide-frontend.ringkas: A pixel-perfect frontend clone of the Antigravity IDE — built with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

solumkm.ringkas: Catat penjualan pakai bahasa sehari-hari (diketik atau diucapkan), biarkan AI merapikan pembukuan dan memberi saran bisnis. Laporan penting bisa dikunci permanen di blockchain agar angkanya bisa dibuktikan apa adanya.

tanki-request.ringkas: Sistem Informasi Permintaan Layanan Mobil Tangki. Aplikasi web (Next.js + MySQL + Keycloak) untuk warga mengajukan permintaan mobil tangki dan operator PDAM mengelola verifikasi, dispatch armada, dan laporan.

tugas-tahap-0-satudata-sulsel.ringkas: Pengumpulan data terbuka Portal Satu Data Sulawesi Selatan (https://satudata.sulselprov.go.id) untuk dipakai sebagai seed data portal data daerah versi baru.

cadensa.ringkas: Pencatat ritme kesehatan reproduksi. Basisnya satu temuan epidemiologis yang jarang dibicarakan: pria yang berejakulasi sekitar 21 kali per bulan menunjukkan angka kejadian kanker prostat yang lebih rendah dibanding pria yang berejakulasi 4–7 kali per bulan. Angka itu diperlakukan sebagai penanda ritme sehat, bukan target yang harus dikejar — dan disebut jujur di dalam produk sebagai korelasi, bukan sebab-akibat.

movv-bmi.ringkas: Aplikasi BMI profesional dengan standar WHO yang dirancang untuk memberikan insight kesehatan yang akurat dan actionable.

pocketledger.ringkas: PocketLedger is a clinical-grade, 100% offline personal finance and expense tracker designed for total privacy, high-speed transaction entry, and beautiful visual analytics.

habitforge.ringkas: HabitForge is a clinical-grade habit tracking application built with Flutter and Firebase. Unlike generic tracking apps, HabitForge leverages behavioral psychology and "Streak Reinforcement" to transform intentions into long-term discipline.

focusforge-pomodoro.ringkas: Many people struggle with digital distractions, procrastination, lack of time management systems, and burnout due to unstructured work. Existing Pomodoro apps are often overly simple, visually outdated, missing analytics and habit tracking, or lacking gamification.

hydraflow-water-reminder.ringkas: Stay Hydrated. Stay Focused. Built with clinical-standard, 100% offline-first intelligence.

quantcoin.ringkas: The current financial infrastructure is a relic of the pre-quantum, pre-AI era. It is slow, fragmented, and vulnerable to the impending "Quantum Apocalypse." QuantCoin is not just another blockchain; it is the Sovereign Quantum Operating System for the next thousand years of human and machine cooperation.

solq.ringkas: SOLQ is a professional, non-custodial payment orchestrator designed for the Solana ecosystem. It enables efficient, low-latency bridging between digital assets and standard payment networks.

vinbryyt-drip-revival.ringkas: "Precision is not an accident; it is the result of high intention and sincere effort." — The Professional Standard.

kopedu-nft-solana.ringkas: Platform edukasi literasi koperasi untuk pelajar Indonesia, dengan sertifikat kelulusan yang diterbitkan sebagai NFT terverifikasi di jaringan Solana.

solgig.ringkas: Social marketplace for Solana creators — sell digital goods, offer services, get paid on-chain. No banks, no chargebacks, no middleman holding funds.

trustpay-sea.ringkas: TrustPay SEA adalah platform escrow berbasis milestone yang memungkinkan freelancer dan klien untuk bertransaksi dengan aman. AI memberikan advisory untuk membantu keputusan, namun final decision selalu di tangan manusia.

nusaharvest.ringkas: Parametric crop insurance and yield pool lending on Solana, built for 73 million Indonesian farmers.

smashgo.ringkas: The ultimate local-first corporate badminton management platform with ELO matchmaking and real-time WhatsApp coordination.
